_meta.author: Claude (draft written from label names and sampled utterances)
_meta.style: 'The user ...' sentences. family = thematic grouping written for this project (not from the source dataset).
_meta.notes: Labels are used verbatim as in banking_data/categories.json, including 'Refund_not_showing_up' and 'reverted_card_payment?'.

activate_my_card.description: The user wants to activate their new card.

card_about_to_expire.description: The user's card is about to expire and they want to know how to renew or replace it.

card_arrival.description: The user asks where their ordered card is or whether it has arrived yet.

card_delivery_estimate.description: The user asks how long the delivery of their card will take.

card_linking.description: The user wants to link an existing card to their account or app.

get_disposable_virtual_card.description: The user wants to get a disposable virtual card.

get_physical_card.description: The user wants to get a physical card.

getting_spare_card.description: The user wants to get a spare or additional card.

getting_virtual_card.description: The user wants to get a virtual card.

order_physical_card.description: The user wants to order a physical card.

card_not_working.description: The user says their card is not working.

card_swallowed.description: The user's card was swallowed by an ATM.

change_pin.description: The user wants to change their card PIN.

compromised_card.description: The user thinks their card has been compromised or used by someone else.

contactless_not_working.description: The user says contactless payments with their card are not working.

lost_or_stolen_card.description: The user reports that their card is lost or stolen.

lost_or_stolen_phone.description: The user reports that their phone is lost or stolen and worries about account security.

pin_blocked.description: The user's PIN is blocked, for example after entering it wrongly.

virtual_card_not_working.description: The user says their virtual card is not working.

Refund_not_showing_up.description: The user was promised a refund but it has not shown up in their account.

card_payment_fee_charged.description: The user was charged a fee for a card payment.

card_payment_not_recognised.description: The user sees a card payment they do not recognise.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.description: The user says a card payment was converted at the wrong exchange rate.

declined_card_payment.description: The user's card payment was declined.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.description: The user sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise.

extra_charge_on_statement.description: The user sees an unexpected extra charge on their statement.

pending_card_payment.description: The user asks about a card payment that is still pending.

request_refund.description: The user wants to request a refund for a payment.

reverted_card_payment?.description: The user asks about a card payment that was reverted or cancelled.

transaction_charged_twice.description: The user says a transaction was charged twice.

atm_support.description: The user asks which ATMs they can use or how to get ATM support.

cash_withdrawal_charge.description: The user was charged a fee for a cash withdrawal.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.description: The user sees a cash withdrawal they do not recognise.

declined_cash_withdrawal.description: The user's cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined.

pending_cash_withdrawal.description: The user asks about a cash withdrawal that is still pending.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.description: The user received a different amount of cash from an ATM than they requested.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.description: The user says a cash withdrawal was converted at the wrong exchange rate.

automatic_top_up.description: The user asks about automatic top-ups or wants to set them up.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.description: The user's balance was not updated after they made a bank transfer.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.description: The user's balance was not updated after they deposited a cheque or cash.

pending_top_up.description: The user asks about a top-up that is still pending.

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.description: The user asks about fees for topping up by bank transfer.

top_up_by_card_charge.description: The user asks about fees for topping up by card.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.description: The user asks how to top up their account with cash or a cheque.

top_up_limits.description: The user asks about the limits on top-ups.

top_up_reverted.description: The user's top-up was reverted or returned.

topping_up_by_card.description: The user asks how to top up their account by card.

verify_top_up.description: The user asks about verifying a top-up or why a top-up needs verification.

beneficiary_not_allowed.description: The user cannot send money to a beneficiary because the beneficiary is not allowed.

cancel_transfer.description: The user wants to cancel a transfer.

pending_transfer.description: The user asks about a transfer that is still pending.

receiving_money.description: The user asks how to receive money into their account.

transfer_fee_charged.description: The user was charged a fee for a transfer.

transfer_into_account.description: The user asks how to transfer money into their account.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.description: The recipient has not received the money the user transferred.

transfer_timing.description: The user asks how long a transfer takes.

exchange_charge.description: The user asks about the fees for exchanging currencies.

exchange_rate.description: The user asks what exchange rate is used for currency exchange.

exchange_via_app.description: The user asks whether and how they can exchange currencies in the app.

fiat_currency_support.description: The user asks which fiat currencies are supported.

edit_personal_details.description: The user wants to change their personal details.

terminate_account.description: The user wants to close their account.

unable_to_verify_identity.description: The user cannot complete the identity verification.

verify_my_identity.description: The user wants to know how to verify their identity.

verify_source_of_funds.description: The user asks how to verify the source of their funds.

why_verify_identity.description: The user asks why they need to verify their identity.

age_limit.description: The user asks about the minimum age to open an account.

apple_pay_or_google_pay.description: The user asks about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with their card.

card_acceptance.description: The user asks where their card is accepted.

country_support.description: The user asks in which countries the service is available.

disposable_card_limits.description: The user asks about the limits of disposable cards.

supported_cards_and_currencies.description: The user asks which cards and currencies are supported.

visa_or_mastercard.description: The user asks whether the card is a Visa or a Mastercard.
